name: eecho
description: Runtime-validated TypeScript API contracts for clients, Express, and MongoDB

scripts.build: npm run build:all && npm run build:example
scripts.build:all: npm run libs:definition:build && npm run libs:api-client:build && npm run libs:express:build
scripts.build:example: npm run build --workspace pestore-server && npm run build --workspace pestore-client
scripts.pack:all: npm run libs:definition:pack && npm run libs:api-client:pack && npm run libs:express:pack
scripts.publish:all: npm run publish:definition && npm run publish:api-client && npm run publish:express
scripts.dry-run:all: npm run dry-run:definition && npm run dry-run:api-client && npm run dry-run:express
scripts.example:pet-store:test: npm run build --workspace pestore-server && npm run build --workspace pestore-client && playwright test --config examples/pestore/playwright.config.js
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run example:pet-store:test

author: eecho
